_film: 005497948 — Selce, 802 images. Several books on one film under DIFFERENT waypoints: image 200 is a «HISTORIA PAROCHIAE», images ~380-400+ are the LIBER DEFUNCTORUM, image 600 is a later Croatian-ruled death register.
_index_warning: The FamilySearch record index holds **baptisms only** for Selce — 119 indexed Antić entries, none of them deaths. The index-with-ARK shortcut does not work for this register; it has to be walked.
_how_to_get_an_ark: https://www.familysearch.org/en/search/film/005497948?i=<N-1> then read the ARK out of document.title. Each navigation wipes injected page scripts, so re-inject the tile reader after every move.
_year_map: Roughly 2.7 images per year through the 1870s-80s. Measured points below; interpolate, then check the printed page number and the year in the TEMPUS MORTIS column.

years.200: HISTORIA PAROCHIAE — parish history, not a register
years.384: LIBER DEFUNCTORUM p. 118 — Aug to Nov 1877
years.397: LIBER DEFUNCTORUM p. 144 — Feb to Jul 1882
years.400: LIBER DEFUNCTORUM p. 150 — Nov 1883 into Feb 1884

_columns: TEMPUS MORTIS (year over day+month, Croatian month names) · Nrus Domus (village + house number) · NOMEN DEFUNCTI et Conditio · sex/status ticks · age in years · remarks, which carry the burial date.
_found_here: Ahnentafel 25 — «Udova Maria Antić, supruga pok. Josipa, kći Jurja i Mare Jeličić, R. Katolikinja», Selce house 29, aged 73, died 6 July 1882, buried 7 July. Image 397, entry 21, ark 3:1:3QSQ-G99X-1357.
